title: Chattering Cuttlefish
statement: A small, palm-sized cuttlefish hovers above fine pale sand and smooth black stones, its skin rippling through soft watercolor washes of sepia, lavender, and seafoam as though thinking out loud. It clicks quietly to no one in particular under warm amber light, rearranging its hues the way a poet rearranges a sentence—never quite settled, always almost saying something.
